t: Solution Pattern Miner - public implementations survey
title: Solution Pattern Miner - public implementations survey
definition: Extracts reusable patterns from prior projects.
description:
This database surveys Solution Pattern Miner as it exists in public practice: Extracts reusable patterns from prior projects. The records below name real tools with real track records, explain the techniques they are built on, cite the standards they implement, and provide drills that build working skill. Nothing here is speculative - every implementation is a real project you can download, every technique is established practice.

The value of a survey like this is comparative: seeing seven real implementations side by side reveals what the capability truly requires and where each tool draws its boundaries. The technique records go deeper, explaining the machinery - the algorithms, protocols and disciplines - that make Solution Pattern Miner work regardless of which tool you pick.

Use this database as a field guide. When a build calls for Solution Pattern Miner, consult the spotlights to choose an implementation, check the standards to stay interoperable, and run the drills to build fluency. Each record's demo program runs with node - the capability is demonstrated end to end.

t: Gang of Four patterns - Solution Pattern Miner implementation spotlight

What makes Gang of Four patterns worth studying is It composes well because it was built to be composed - clean boundaries, documented formats, and no hidden global state. Practitioners choose it when correctness must be auditable end to end, and avoid it when the job needs something it deliberately does not do. t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Solution Pattern
